inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Set up an ongoing quality assessment and assurance group to review quality deficiencies  and develop corrective plans of action
inspections.detail: Set up an ongoing quality assessment and assurance group to review quality deficiencies  and develop corrective plans of action.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Food not served at a safe or appetizing temperature
inspections.detail: Ensure food and drink is palatable, attractive, and at a safe and appetizing temperature.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

inspections.title: Transfer / bed-hold notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

inspections.title: Pre-admission screening not coordinated
inspections.detail: Coordinate assessments with the pre-admission screening and resident review program; and referring for services as needed.

inspections.title: Help with daily activities not provided
inspections.detail: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.

inspections.title: Pressure sores not prevented or treated
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Breathing / oxygen care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.

inspections.title: Trauma-informed care not provided
inspections.detail: Provide care or services that was trauma informed and/or culturally competent.

inspections.title: Pharmacist drug review not done properly
inspections.detail: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

inspections.title: Kitchen not properly staffed
inspections.detail: Employ sufficient staff with the appropriate competencies and skills sets to carry out the functions of the food and nutrition service, including a qualified dietician.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Suspected abuse or neglect not reported on time
inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.

inspections.title: Hired someone with an abuse/neglect record
inspections.detail: Not hire anyone with a finding of abuse, neglect, exploitation, or theft.

inspections.title: Medications not labeled or stored correctly
inspections.detail: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

inspections.title: Menus not meeting nutrition needs
inspections.detail: Ensure menus must meet the nutritional needs of residents, be prepared in advance, be followed, be updated, be reviewed by dietician, and meet the needs of the resident.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Privacy not protected
inspections.detail: Keep residents' personal and medical records private and confidential.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Incontinence or catheter care problems
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.

inspections.title: Unnecessary medications given
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.

inspections.title: COVID-19 vaccine education not done
inspections.detail: Educate residents and staff on COVID-19 vaccination, offer the COVID-19 vaccine to eligible residents and staff after education, and properly document each resident and staff member's vaccination status.

inspections.title: Resident was abused or neglected
inspections.detail: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Care plan incomplete
inspections.detail: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
